text.1_, 50_Daf, 0_Line: If one warned one's wife and she is pregnant or nursing, we make/let her drink and we do not wait for her until she gives birth or completes her time of nursing, because if she is pure (i.e. not guilty of adultery) there is no concern, and if she she is impure (i.e. guilty of ipurity) her fetus is no more (important than in the) capital case, where the woman who is taken out to be executed we do not wait for her (to give birth) unless she already sat on the birthing stool nor if she is nursing is she allowed to nurse.
text.1_, 86_Daf, 4_Line: A person should always strive to have a house, before they strive for other possessions, and after that they should strive for other possessions like vineyards and fields, and after that they should marry. The Torah alluded to this - "Who is the man" etc (Devarim 20:5) - house is placed before vineyard and vineyard before wife. And King Shlomo in his wisdom said “Prepare your work outside, and make it fit for yourself in the field; and afterward build your house” (Mishlei 24:27). “Prepare your work outside”; this is a house. “And make it fit for yourself in the field”; this is a vineyard and other possessions. “And afterward you shall build your house”; this is a wife. And whilst on the topic, they taught it another way: "Prepare your work outside"; this is Torah, Mishnah, and Talmud. "And make it fit for yourself in the field"; these are good deeds, meaning to say, degrees and attributes of character. "And build a house"; that you should study and receive reward, meaning that you should influence your counterpart.
